<section class="mod_article section-primary grass-light block" id="article-409">
<div class="grid">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">The Baltic Sea from every angle. Be right in the middle of it.</h2>
<h3 class="ce_headline col-12">Enjoy your vacation on Fehmarn with the whole family</h3>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-6 block">
<p>Are you looking for a truly special vacation? We have just the thing. In a one-of-a-kind location. Discover our fantastic setting between Lake Burger and the Baltic Sea.</p>
<p>Here, breathtaking natural beauty meets a vast array of recreational and entertainment activities. Water sports enthusiasts will find the best conditions for riding the waves on their kiteboards or surfboards.</p>
<p>At our award-winning campground, you can enjoy your vacation with the whole family: dining options, entertainment, musicals, shows, and live bands promise an unforgettable getaway all year round.</p>
<p>Whether on the beautiful sandy beach, in the refreshing pool, or at one of our many playgrounds&mdash;the kids can run around and play while you listen to the waves and enjoy the sun. And Fehmarn, the &ldquo;Sun Island,&rdquo; gets more sunshine than anywhere else in Germany.</p>
</div>
<div class="col-12_lg-6">
<div class="ce_text block">
<p>For your Baltic Sea vacation, we want to offer you everything you're looking for: comfortable accommodations, friendly service, and attractive <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Gastronomy</strong> and great recreational activities for the whole family. We place a high priority on quality, comfort, and activities.</p>
<p>Whether it's a caravan site, a motorhome site, a mobile home, a vacation apartment, a vacation home, or <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Rental Trailers</strong> &ndash; Plan your vacation exactly the way you want it. And whenever you want. With our wide variety of <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Accommodations</strong> We're open for you all year round.</p>
<p><strong>Don't settle for less&mdash;experience something special. Are you ready?</strong></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

But even as a regular guest, you can book these offers for your vacation on the Baltic Sea!</p>

<section class="mod_article section-primary wulfi block" id="article-587">
<div class="grid">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_lg-5 headline-border">News for Your Vacation</h2>
<div class="mod_newslist block">
<div class="news news-teaser grid block first even" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Article">
<div class="news-teaser-content col-12">
<p class="info"><time datetime="2025-11-25T12:36:00+01:00" itemprop="datePublished">25.11.2025</time>  </p>
<h2 itemprop="name" style="pointer-events:none;"><a href="news-detail/wir-sind-gefragtester-platz-europas" title='Den Artikel lesen: Wir sind: "gefragtester Platz Europas"!'>We are: "Europe's most sought-after destination"!</a></h2>
<div class="ce_text block" itemprop="description">
<p>Great excitement on the sunny island of Fehmarn: The &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; camping and vacation park has claimed the top spot in the European rankings. According to the latest analysis by the ADAC camping portal PiNCAMP, &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; is the most sought-after campground in all of Europe.</p>        </div>
<a href="news-detail/wir-sind-gefragtester-platz-europas" title='Den Artikel lesen: Wir sind: "gefragtester Platz Europas"!'>Read more &hellip;<span class="invisible"> Wir sind: "gefragtester Platz Europas"!</span></a>            </div>
</div><div class="news news-teaser grid block last odd" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Article">
<div class="news-teaser-content col-12">
<p class="info"><time datetime="2025-06-24T10:29:00+02:00" itemprop="datePublished">24.06.2025</time>  </p>
<h2 itemprop="name" style="pointer-events:none;"><a href="news-detail/unsere-wulfener-hals-app" title="Den Artikel lesen: Unsere Wulfener Hals App">Our "Wulfener Hals" App</a></h2>
<div class="ce_text block" itemprop="description">
<p>Want to stay up to date? Then download our "Wulfener Hals" app!</p>        </div>
<a href="news-detail/unsere-wulfener-hals-app" title="Den Artikel lesen: Unsere Wulfener Hals App">Read more &hellip;<span class="invisible"> Unsere Wulfener Hals App</span></a>            </div>

<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Water Sports and Beach Activities</h2>
<p>On your marks, get set, go! Here, vacationers and day-trippers alike can really get active on the beach. Surfing, kitesurfing, sailing, wakeboarding, or scuba diving&mdash;anything is possible.</p>
<p>And all this against a unique backdrop. Professionals and beginners alike come from far and wide to enjoy their sport in the Wulfener Hals surf area on Burger Binnensee or on the open Baltic Sea.</p>

<section class="mod_article section-primary grass-dark block" id="article-814">
<div class="grid-spaceBetween">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_md-7 headline-border">
Our new "Wulfener Hals" app</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-7 button button-primary block">
<p>Great service right on your phone: Our app <strong>Wulfener Hals Camping and Vacation Park</strong> provides you with information, tips, and ideas for your Baltic Sea vacation.</p>
<p>Whether it's events, our entertainment program, or our hours of operation&mdash;you'll find everything in our new app. You can also easily request a spa appointment or contact the front desk&mdash;we're here to help you with advice and assistance.</p>
<p><a href="https://portal.gastfreund.net/wulfener-hals" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Go to the web version of the app</a></p>
</div>

<p><strong>Luxury accommodations:</strong><br><strong>Glamour meets camping.</strong><br>Everything is already set up for you:</p>
<p>Whether you stay in our luxurious mobile homes and vacation homes or our comfortable rental trailers&mdash;enjoy your vacation at the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; without having to bring your own trailer.</p>
